PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: The catalogue environment's light, camera and style, and the pictures the factory writes: every asset drawn the same way, so the catalogue reads as one set.

PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Styl.Note: The starting style (the app as it boots), with a fixed seed, the default sun and a sky left as paper: the asset is the only thing on the sheet. The stage itself (the disc of ground, no building) is 16__Scene__AssetLibrary's.
PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Styl.SeedNote: One hand for the whole catalogue: a re-render draws the same picture
PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Styl.SunNote: The cottage's default sun: light from the left and in front, shadow to the right and behind
PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Styl.SkyNote: No sky wash and no clouds: reserved paper round the asset

PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Came.Note: A three-quarter view from a little above, fitted to the asset's bounds: Fill is the share of the square picture its height or its spread (whichever is the greater) takes.

PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Pict.Note: Each picture is the sheet's centre square, scaled: the camera puts the asset in the middle of it.
PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Pict.SizePxNote: Square, sharp at a card's size and at a SketchUp or three.js preview's
PainterlyNPR__AssetFactory__Config__Pict.ApiNote: The local server's route: POST /api/assets/<AssetId>/<Slot> writes one file into the asset's own folder
